title: Oven Roasted Vietnamese Pork Skewers
description: A bitter and velvety Vietnamese dish featuring chilli powder, perfect for a solo dinner, with a smoky and hot flavor profile, and is keto-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together chilli powder, fish sauce, coconut oil, lime juice, garlic, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
